messages:
Noah (AE): starting a thread for RivalCorp migration POC. They want minimal code changes, strict parity for 3 regulatory prompts, pricing comparison, and SSO/KMS. SE + Sec + Pricing please chime in.

Lina (SE): quick context: RivalCorp uses /v1/complete sync calls, ~400k tokens/day, avg prompt 80 tokens. Main asks: exact-match for golden set, and clear token billing on retries.

Oscar (RivalCorp Eng): We have 3 golden templates + 1k sample prompts. Will need sandbox and IP allowlist. Determinism is critical for audits.

Lina (SE): Plan: provide adapter snippet, run parity harness (metrics: exact-match for golden, semantic sim, token delta). Smoke of 200 prompts tonight, full 1.2k run during POC week. Adapter example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"{{prompt}}","model":"redwood-lite"}'
```

June (Security): BYOK/KMS supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted uses envelope with our keys by default. Log retention default 90d masked; can extend on Dedicated with contract. We need them to fill vendor questionnaire.

Felix (Pricing): ballpark hosted: $0.0065 / 1k gen tokens. Dedicated estimate for given volume: ~$30k/mo (6mo term) — will refine with invoices. Onboarding fee applies for Private.

infra-bot: sandbox for rivalcorp ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/rivalcorp (key: RIV_TEST_12). egress IPs: 34.123.45.10, 34.123.45.11.

Oscar (RivalCorp Eng): got it, starting smoke tonight if we get adapter + harness.

Lina (SE): Acceptance criteria submitted by RivalCorp: 1) golden prompts exact match 100%. 2) semantic sim >=0.95 on samples. 3) avg token billing delta <=4%. 4) p95 latency <300ms on Dedicated. 5) no 5xxs during fallback.

Noah (AE): scheduling kick-off with RivalCorp, SE, Sec, Pricing tomorrow 11am PT. I'll request invoices and questionnaire.

June (Security): I'll prefill questionnaire and flag BYOK SLA + retention for legal.

Lina (SE): I'll drop adapter repo link and runbook after this thread. :thumbsup:
